name: conflict-core
description: Conflict Core — online multiplayer real-time strategy game for the browser (desktop and mobile).

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @conflict/server & npm run dev -w @conflict/client
scripts.build: npm run build -w @conflict/client && npm run build -w @conflict/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run validate-data
